text: はないち　もんめ　して　あそんでる　わけじゃ　ないよ　ちゃんと　たたかうもん

structure.jp: はないち　もんめ　して　あそんでる
ちゃんと　たたかうもん

patterns.name: 〜わけではない
patterns.explanation: わけではない after a statement means 'it's not that...'; じゃ is the casual form of では. あそんでる　わけじゃ　ない = 'it's not that we're playing'.

patterns.name: 〜もの
patterns.explanation: もん is the casual form of もの at the end of a sentence, a childlike way of giving your reason or sticking up for yourself. たたかうもん = 'because we do battle!'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; here it is shortened to でる, as in casual speech. あそんでる = 'are playing'.
